user.title: Add a Lumia HiFi receiver
user.description: Pick the name Home Assistant should show. A new secret is generated for this receiver on the next screen.

secret.title: Connect the Lumia app
secret.description:
In the Lumia HiFi app, open Settings, Home Assistant, then enter:

**Address:** `{url}`

**Secret:** `{secret}`

The secret is shown only once. If you lose it, rotate it from the integration options.

data.rotate_secret: Generate a new secret (disconnects the phone until it is updated)

secret.title: New secret
secret.description:
Enter this in the Lumia HiFi app:

**Address:** `{url}`

**Secret:** `{secret}`

The secret is shown only once.
